Article Title: Don't be a Baahubali: SC to Bihar judge over criminal case against SP
Article Text:
SC flags the judge's behaviour, says every judge must knowcontours of his jurisdiction

Pitiable plight

NEW DELHI: An additional sessions judge in Bihar's Sasaram was chastised on Monday by Supreme Court which took exception to him flexing his position and getting a criminal case registered against a superintendent of police who did not carry out his order, and asked the judge "not to be Quixotic or play Robin Hood or Baahubali of Bihar".The ASJ, in a criminal trial, had directed the SP to file an FIR against a witness for deposing falsely. After his repeated summons were not complied with, the judge directed the Bihar chief secretary to take disciplinary action against the SP.When that did not work, the ASJ directed a criminal case against the SP and asked him to appear in court Aug 22. After two adjournments, the SP's counsel sought permission for virtual appearance on the grounds that he was supervising flood relief.In the meantime, the inspecting judge from the HC asked the sessions judge to meet him with the case records in Patna on Sept 24, which the judicial officer declined saying "it was very humiliating and demoralising" for him. On Sept 29, the sessions judge convicted the SP for flouting court orders and fined him Re 1.On the state govt's appeal, Patna HC criticised the judicial officer's conduct and asked him to be circumspect and exercise caution in future.Hurt by these remarks, the judicial officer appealed against the HC judgment before the SC and said, "The present case depicts the pitiable plight of judicial officers once they pass any order against an IAS or IPS officer. The entire system tends to protect them, leaving judicial officers high and dry. "A bench of Chief Justice Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana said every judge was bound by procedure and asked if a district judge could behave like this? "When an inspecting judge asks you to meet him, why would you not go?" the bench asked."Every judge must know the contours of his jurisdiction. Don't be Quixotic or a Robin Hood," the bench said and asked the judicial officer's counsel Prem Prakash to convey to him not "to become Baahubali of Bihar".The bench said in its order, "Regardless of the observations made by the HC in its Oct 8 order, we request the HC to consider petitioner judicial officer's explanation-cum-apology sympathetically and dispose of the pending proceedings."On another judicial officer's petition complaining about promotion and selection to higher judicial service, the CJI-led bench said, "It has become a fashion for judicial officers to rush to the SC directly without approaching the HCs concerned. They are thinking 24x7 about promotion, increase in salary and perks and extension of retirement age, paying little attention to deal with huge pendency."
Article Summary: An additional sessions judge in Bihar's Sasaram was chastised on Monday by Supreme Court. He got a criminal case registered against a superintendent of police who did not carry out his order. The ASJ, in a criminal trial, had directed the SP to file an FIR against a witness for deposing falsely.

Article Title: Monsoon session not yet prorogued, Congress slams government
Article Text:

NEW DELHI: Congress expressed apprehension that something "truly sinister" is being planned by Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union home minister Amit Shah, as it lashed out at the absence of information on the upcoming Parliament session . It argued that dates of winter session or the special session should have been out by now.The winter session is due soon while monsoon session has not been prorogued yet after the passage of 100 days since it was adjourned, resulting in unending speculation about a special session for delimitation bill.AICC spokesman Jairam Ramesh said, "What games are being played by the PM-HM jodi, assuming that the jodi is still together?" He said the country should have known by now when the winter session will take place, or when the monsoon session will be reconvened (special session)."By now having seen (through) the desperate efforts of the jodi to cobble together a super-tainted two-thirds majority in Lok Sabha, the nation is entitled to know what the PM-HM formula for delimitation is, assuming that there is indeed one," he said.Ramesh said the suspense about Parliament and delimitation bill suggests the PM-HM jodi "is trapped by its own bluff and bluster" and "there is something truly sinister that is being planned."He said the "two GTA (Gyanesh Theft Arrangers) stars" stand brutally exposed but the "shenanigans of the diabolical duo" are diminishing the institution of Parliament.
Article Summary: Congress expresses apprehension that something "truly sinister" is being planned. It lashed out at the absence of information on the upcoming Parliament session. NEW DELHI: Bharatiya Janata Party BJP ) and Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) on Tuesday sounded the poll bugle in Punjab, announcing an alliance for the 2027 assembly elections and reviving their partnership after a six-year break. The two parties will jointly contest all 117 seats, with the Akali Dal taking the lead in the alliance."Big brother will be Akali Dal. We will contest all 117 seats.(The elder brother becomes the chief minister)," Union home minister Amit Shah said at a joint press conference attended by BJP president Nitin Nabin and SAD president Sukhbir Singh Badal."Naturally, the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) will play the role of the elder brother. The Akali Dal and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) will contest together. Both parties will jointly contest all 117 seats, while the Akali Dal will be in the role of the elder brother," he added.Shah said tackling drugs, corruption and law and order would be the alliance's key priorities in Punjab, a border state."The biggest hallmark of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and the National Democratic Alliance ( NDA ) is that wherever there is an NDA government, law and order has remained sound.Both of our parties have discussed several issues concerning Punjab, and we have a consensus on them," he said."Our topmost priority will be a drug-free Punjab, fixing law and order to provide security in this border state, and eliminating these gangs. This is our topmost priority, and it will be the foremost issue in the manifestos of both parties," he added.Shah further stated that a detailed manifesto would be finalised soon by the two parties for the elections, but eradicating the drug menace from Punjab and promoting Hindu-Sikh unity would be among the key focus areas."BJP, the Akali Dal, and the NDA will contest in Punjab, and we will announce several key points in our manifesto. But, I want to make one thing very clear: eliminating drugs from Punjab will be our primary goal, eliminating corruption in Punjab will be our primary goal, and strengthening nationalist forces in Punjab will also be our primary goal. The current government in the state, led by Kejriwal Ji, had come to power promising to eliminate drugs within three months. They promised to eliminate drugs, but the problem has not been eradicated; it has increased. In 2017, Rahul Gandhi Ji had promised that drugs would be eliminated within one term. He made that promise, but his party also did nothing to address the drug problem. Now, I want to reiterate a promise that I made there: by December 31, 2029, we will make Punjab completely drug-free," he added.Delhi minister and BJP leader Manjinder Singh Sirsa said Sukhbir Singh Badal would be the chief ministerial face of the BJP-SAD alliance in Punjab.Speaking to ANI, Sirsa said the alliance was formed with a broader vision of addressing Punjab's problems rather than merely capturing political power. He said its priorities included making the state free of drugs, gangsters and debt, besides resolving farmers' issues.He also congratulated Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Shah, Nitin Nabin and Badal on the alliance, and welcomed the SAD's return to NDA.The announcement, made on Gurpurab, comes with a symbolic connection to the events that led to the breakdown of the alliance.The alliance marks a revival of ties between the BJP and SAD, which parted ways in 2020 after the Akali Dal withdrew from the NDA over its opposition to the now-repealed farm laws.Under their previous seat-sharing arrangement, the BJP contested 23 of Punjab's 117 assembly seats, while the SAD fought the remaining constituencies.The two parties had jointly governed Punjab for 10 years before losing the 2017 assembly elections. Congress returned to power under Captain Amarinder Singh.In 2022, the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) swept the state, while the BJP and SAD, which contested separately, were pushed to the margins.Meanwhile, the Punjab BJP on Monday announced its 16-member state election committee for the 2027 assembly elections, with state president Kewal Singh Dhillon heading the panel.The committee comprises senior party leaders and former state presidents and has been tasked with preparing the party's electoral roadmap and framing a comprehensive chargesheet against the incumbent government.
Article Summary: The two parties will jointly contest all 117 seats, with the Akali Dal taking the lead in the alliance. Union home minister Amit Shah said tackling drugs, corruption and law and order would be the alliance's key priorities in Punjab. Sukhbir Singh Badal will be the chief ministerial face of the BJP-SAD alliance.

Article Title: 'People will decide': Supriya Sule rejects speculation over father Sharad Pawar's 'retirement'

NEW DELHI: NCP SP leader Supriya Sule on Tuesday dismissed media reports speculating that her father and party president Sharad Pawar could retire from active politics on his birthday next month.Speaking to reporters, Sule pointed out that Sharad Pawar is still a Rajya Sabha member, with five years remaining in his term."People will decide who will retire," the Baramati MP added.Her remarks came amid speculation in Maharashtra's political circles after several media reports suggested that Sharad Pawar, a former chief minister and ex-Union minister, could retire from active politics on December 12, his 86th birthday.The veteran politician was hospitalised twice earlier this month due to a chest and respiratory infection.Meanwhile, Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said discussions about Sharad Pawar's retirement were "not appropriate.""We wish Sharad Pawar excellent health. He is active even today. I have seen him closely; he continuously takes an interest in various projects and work. Therefore, discussing his retirement is not appropriate," Fadnavis said, adding that there was no basis for such speculation.Sharad Pawar co-founded the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) in 1999 and led it for 24 years before his nephew Ajit Pawar rebelled and joined the BJP-led Maharashtra government in 2023.The Election Commission recognised Ajit Pawar's faction as the "real" NCP, while Sharad Pawar's faction was given the name Nationalist Congress Party (Sharadchandra Pawar), or NCP (SP).Ajit Pawar died in a plane crash in Baramati in January.
Article Summary: Sharad Pawar is still a Rajya Sabha member, with five years remaining in his term. Sule's remarks come amid speculation in Maharashtra's political circles. Maharashtra chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said discussions about Pawar's retirement were "not appropriate"

Article Title: 'Wait and watch': Prakash Rajbhar said many SP leaders may join BJP ahead of 2027 UP polls

He alleged that some SP leaders were already in contact with people in Delhi and Uttar Pradesh to explore the possibility of switching parties.According to news agency ANI, Rajbhar said several SP leaders wanted to secure another assembly ticket and win elections under the BJP banner."There are many people within the Samajwadi Party who wish to be re-elected as MLAs, secure a party ticket, and win under the BJP banner. Article Title: 6 years after split, BJP and SAD set to reunite in poll-bound Punjab
Article Text:
BJP eyes bigger role in Punjab as it prepares to reunite with SAD ahead of polls

NEW DELHI: Bharatiya Janata Party and Shiromani Akali Dal are expected to announce their alliance for the upcoming Punjab assembly elections on Tuesday in a joint presser.The press conference, scheduled for 1pm at the BJP headquarters in New Delhi, will be attended by Union home minister Amit Shah , BJP chief Nitin Nabin and SAD supremo Sukhbir Singh Badal , news agency ANI reported.The alliance marks a revival of ties between the two parties, which ended their decades-old partnership in 2020 after the Akali Dal walked out of the NDA over the now-repealed farm laws. Under their previous arrangement, the BJP contested 23 of Punjab's 117 assembly seats, with the SAD fighting the remaining constituencies.BJP sources had earlier indicated that the party would contest a substantially higher number of seats than it did under the previous arrangement, as it seeks to expand its political footprint in the state. The party has been stepping up its outreach in Punjab, with an aggressive campaign against drug addiction and opposition to religious conversions by missionaries among its key planks. It has also inducted leaders from other political parties.The BJP's growing electoral ambitions in the state come against the backdrop of its improved vote share in the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. The party secured over 18% of the votes in Punjab, compared with the SAD's over 13%.The SAD, once a dominant regional force, has seen its political fortunes decline, particularly after the Aam Aadmi Party swept to power in the state in the 2022 assembly elections.
Article Summary: BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal expected to announce alliance for Punjab elections. The alliance marks a revival of ties between the two parties, which ended their decades-old partnership in 2020. Under their previous arrangement, the BJP contested 23 of Punjab's 117 assembly seats, with the SAD fighting the remaining constituencies.

Article Title: ‘No one should be exempted from law’: Congress presses ally Vijay over collector's complaint against TVK MLA
Article Text:
Congress presses ally Vijay govt to act

NEW DELHI: Congress MP Manickam Tagore on Monday demanded immediate legal action against TVK MLA C Arul Vignesh after reports that the Kallakurichi district collector had filed a formal complaint against him with the Superintendent of Police.Reacting to a report, Tagore said the development was shocking and called for a case to be registered against the MLA under relevant legal provisions without delay. He also urged the Tamil Nadu government to intervene and ensure justice for the district collector.“The information published in The Hindu is shocking. Given that the affected female official herself has filed a complaint, a case must be registered immediately against the Kallakurichi Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA), Arul Vignesh, under the relevant legal provisions, and legal action must be taken without any delay,” he wrote in a post on X.Tagore said the government was responsible for ensuring the dignity and safety of women officials in public positions and stressed that no one should be above the law because of their position.“It is the duty of the government to ensure the dignity and safety of a female official serving in a public position. No one should be exempted from the law simply because they hold power,” he said.“The government must intervene immediately and take appropriate action to ensure that justice is served for the Kallakurichi District Collector,” he added.DMK MP Kanimozhi also praised the district collector for filing a police complaint against the TVK MLA over allegations of inappropriate behaviour. She questioned chief minister Vijay over the alleged delay in taking action against the legislator.In a post on X, Kanimozhi said she had earlier called for an investigation and government action after reports of the MLA's alleged behaviour towards the district collector emerged.“When reports emerged that TVK MLA Arul Vignesh had behaved inappropriately with the District Collector, I kept insisting that this be investigated and that the government take action,” she said.She also questioned those who had criticised her, other political leaders and the DMK for raising the issue, accusing them of politicising concerns over women's safety.“What will those who questioned me, other political leaders and the DMK that day, and accused even those who spoke about women’s safety of playing politics, say today?” she said.Praising the district collector for approaching the police against a ruling-party MLA, Kanimozhi said her action would set an example for women facing harassment at their workplaces.She also questioned Vijay over the alleged lack of action against the MLA and asked whether the chief minister would act or continue to prioritise protecting his party colleague over women's safety."I wholeheartedly commend the Kallakurichi district collector, who courageously filed a police complaint against a ruling-party MLA and is setting an example for all women enduring harassment in their workplaces. Will chief minister Vijay , who has failed to take action against his party’s MLA even after all this time, finally act? Or will he continue to take the position that protecting his party member, who faces such vile allegations, is more important than women’s safety?” she questioned.“Justice delayed is justice denied. Will action finally be taken now?” she further asked.Meanwhile, the National Commission for Women (NCW) has taken suo motu cognisance of the incident. In a post on X, the commission said a media report had referred to allegations of earlier misbehaviour and the MLA's alleged visit to the collector's residence in an inebriated condition.NCW chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar has written to the Tamil Nadu director general of police, seeking a fair and impartial inquiry into the allegations. The commission has also sought a detailed Action Taken Report (ATR) within seven days.
Article Summary: Congress MP Manickam Tagore demands immediate legal action against TVK MLA C Arul Vignesh. DMK MP Kanimozhi praised the district collector for filing a police complaint against the MLA over allegations of inappropriate behaviour. National Commission for Women has taken suo motu cognisance of the incident.

Article Title: SP’s ‘Jan-Man Manifesto’: Akhilesh Yadav to unveil 2027 poll roadmap on Constitution Day
Article Text:
Samajwadi Party National President Akhilesh Yadav

With the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections approaching, Samajwadi Party (SP) president Akhilesh Yadav is set to release the party's election manifesto on Thursday, coinciding with Constitution Day . Titled the 'Jan-Man Manifesto' (Manifesto of the People), the document will be presented as the party's 'PDA Pranpatra', with a focus on constitutional protection, democracy, reservation and social justice.The manifesto, reportedly prepared under the supervision of former Uttar Pradesh chief secretary Alok Ranjan, is expected to outline the party's commitments on employment, education, reservation and welfare measures for women, young people and marginalised communities. The party is also planning separate region-specific and district-level manifestos to take its proposals to voters at the grassroots level.The PDA, a political formulation promoted by Yadav, refers to Pichhde (backward classes), Dalits and Alpsankhyak (minorities). The SP has indicated that releasing its manifesto months before the polls will allow it to take its proposals to the public ahead of the election campaign.On October 19, announcing the decision on X, Yadav had said, "Sattais ka Sankalp: PDA ka Prannpatra (Resolve for 2027: PDA's pledge)."He added that the 'Jan-Man Manifesto' would be released on the "democratic and sacred occasion" of Constitution Day.The manifesto announcement comes amid a series of attacks by Yadav on the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) over governance and election preparedness.Addressing a press conference in Lucknow on Saturday, the SP chief said his party would approach the Election Commission of India (ECI) against government officials whom he accused of functioning as BJP agents. He said the proposed representation would carry signatures of the party's MLAs, MLCs and MPs."After consulting with my party colleagues, I will certainly write to the Election Commission," Yadav said, alleging that the ruling party was misusing its position.He also claimed that the BJP would be effectively defeated once the election schedule was announced, saying voters were waiting for the poll dates.Meanwhile, Yadav said discussions over alliance arrangements for the 2027 elections were still underway, with defeating the BJP remaining the party's primary objective.The 403-member Uttar Pradesh Assembly is due to go to polls in 2027, with the election schedule yet to be announced.
Article Summary: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav is set to release the party's election manifesto on Thursday. Titled the 'Jan-Man Manifesto' (Manifesto of the People), it will focus on constitutional protection, democracy, reservation and social justice. The SP has indicated that releasing its manifesto months before the polls will allow it to take its proposals to the public.

NEW DELHI: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke in another X post on Monday claimed that the local Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) in his hometown had “suddenly gone on leave” and that a new officer had been brought in to take charge.Dipke’s remarks came amid party's earlier claim that he and fellow CJP leaders Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Dass could be arrested before October 10 under the National Security Act (NSA) or other provisions.AISA national president Neha Bora on Monday claimed that protesting journalists have been detained at the Delhi Cantonment Police Station.In a post on X, Neha said "Rosy and other protesting journalists are detained at Delhi Cantt PS. The protesters have been demanding accountability from chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the exercise and have announced further mobilisation on October 10 in Delhi.

Article Title: 'I want Brezza': Delhi cop cancels wedding for not getting preferred car in dowry, suspended
Article Text:
A controversial incident involving a Delhi Police constable, Kuldeep, has led to his suspension after his wedding was reportedly derailed by dowry demands

NEW DELHI: A Delhi Police constable was suspended Monday for allegedly cancelling his wedding after his specific demand for dowry went unmet.The action was taken after senior officers took note of the allegations against constable Kuldeep, posted in Outer North District.“Taking note of the allegations regarding the demand for dowry and the subsequent calling off of the marriage, the misconduct of constable Kuldeep has been viewed seriously. Accordingly, he has been placed under suspension with immediate effect, pending departmental action. The incident pertains to Sonipat, Haryana, on Nov 20,” a statement by Delhi Police read.The groom, Kuldeep, allegedly insisted on a Maruti Suzuki Brezza instead of the Hyundai Aura booked by the bride’s family, reportedly describing the latter as a vehicle commonly used as a taxi. Following the disagreement, he returned with nearly 30 members of the wedding party, leaving the bride at the mandap.According to the complaint filed by the bride’s father, Subhash Kumar , his daughter Hina’s marriage had been fixed with Kuldeep around six months ago. Both families had mutually agreed to solemnise the marriage on Nov 20, following which the preparations began.Kuldeep has denied the allegations before reporters, calling them “baseless”.“I have not demanded a Brezza car or even a bicycle. The marriage had been fixed, and I had suggested that we keep the initial ceremony small, but they said they would organise a grand celebration. Whatever they gave us, we accepted with due respect. There was no demand from our side, nor was there any issue between the families,” he said.
Article Summary: A Delhi Police constable was suspended Monday for allegedly cancelling his wedding after his specific demand for dowry went unmet. Article Title: Son of Delhi doctor accused of killing domestic help dies; father moves court for interim bail
Article Text:
In photos: The accused Dr Manish Gupta; the victim domestic help





NEW DELHI: Dr Manish Gupta, an accused in the domestic help murder case, has approached a Delhi court seeking three weeks' interim bail following the death of his 19-year-old son, Parth Gupta, on November 19.Gupta has sought temporary release to attend his son's last rites and be with his family during the bereavement. He is currently in judicial custody after being arrested by Delhi Police on June 18, 2026, and is facing trial in the murder case before Saket District Court.Additional Sessions Judge Anuj Aggarwal took note of the application and directed Delhi Police to submit a verification report. The court has listed the matter for hearing on Saturday.Moving the application on Gupta's behalf, advocate Kamal Nayan Tiwari submitted that the accused was facing an extremely difficult situation following the sudden death of his only child. He argued that Gupta, as the deceased's father, had an emotional and moral responsibility to attend the last rites, but his continued custody had prevented him from doing so.The counsel told the court that he received a call from Gupta's wife on November 20, informing him that their 19-year-old son had died a day earlier. The application stated that the death had come as a devastating shock to the family and that Gupta was unable to be present with them because he was in custody.Parth was also named as a suspect in the charge sheet filed by Delhi Police in the domestic help murder case and had been questioned during the investigation.
Article Summary: Dr Manish Gupta, an accused in the domestic help murder case, has approached a Delhi court seeking three weeks' interim bail. His 19-year-old son, Parth Gupta, died on November 19. Gupta is currently in judicial custody after being arrested by Delhi Police on June 18, 2026.

Article Title: Rajasthan Congress chief demands CM Sharma resign over panchayat poll setback
Article Text:
PCC Chief Govind dotasara and LoP Tikaram Jully with Party workers Celebrate Panchayati Raj election results Friday





JAIPUR: Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) president Govind Singh Dotasra Friday demanded the resignation of chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and his cabinet, terming BJP’s setback in panchayat elections as “public anger” over alleged corruption, administrative lapses and unfulfilled promises.Addressing a news conference at the Congress office in Jaipur, Dotasra said the state govt was focused on optics rather than governance. “The state govt appears more interested in publicity and ceremonial events than addressing people’s problems,” he said.Taking aim at Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’s earlier description of BJP’s urban local body performance as a “landslide victory,” Dotasra argued the results did not support the claim. He said BJP’s lead over Congress was marginal and claimed that “nearly 64% of voters voted against it” in the urban polls.“People have exposed the PM’s claim (in rural polls). Modi should be wary of the ‘facts’ fed to him by Rajasthan BJP, which only ends up embarrassing him,” Dotasra said.He reiterated his demand for resignations, saying, “If the CM and his ministers have even a little moral responsibility left, they should resign and tell the PM and the Union home minister that they have failed to meet the expectations of Rajasthan’s people.”Dotasra alleged the Sharma govt failed to address inflation, healthcare, fertiliser and seed availability for farmers, employment and women’s safety. Referring to alleged irregularities in medicines and medical equipment supplied to pregnant women, he accused the govt of evading accountability for maternal deaths. He also alleged that job seekers were facing police action. Unemployed youth, he said, were being met with “batons and police action instead of recruitment opportunities. ”Dotasra also criticised Sharma over remarks directed at former chief minister Ashok Gehlot , saying Gehlot’s advice to keep relatives away from govt affairs stemmed from his experience as a three-term CM. “Instead of addressing the issue, the current CM appears rattled. The language he used against a former CM was unacceptable. Even a street drunkard would not use such language,” Dotasra said.Questioning Sharma’s emphasis on high-profile visits and public events, Dotasra took a swipe at the ceremonial aspects of VIP tours. “A ‘Radhe Radhe’ stole, a memento, a helicopter ride and visits by the PM and the Union HM—but what did Rajasthan’s people get? You are not running an event management company; you are running a govt,” he said.
Article Summary: Rajasthan Pradesh Congress Committee (PCC) president Govind Singh Dotasra Friday demanded the resignation of chief minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and his cabinet. He terming BJP’s setback in panchayat elections as “public anger” over alleged corruption, administrative lapses and unfulfilled promises.

Article Title: 60-year-old woman raped by neighbour after threat of physical harm near Banjara Hills hospital, accused sent to judicial remand
Article Text:
Hyderabad:





A 60-year-old woman was allegedly raped by a 32-year-old neighbour near a hospital in Banjara Hills. Police arrested the accused and sent him to judicial remand on Tuesday.The 60-year-old woman from a locality near Road Number 10, Banjara Hills, works as a domestic help. During the early hours of Sunday, she went near a hospital on Road Number 10, Banjara Hills, to collect blankets being distributed.She collected blankets and later went to the bushes near the road to attend nature’s call. The 32-year-old accused, who is the neighbour of the victim, spotted her going to a secluded spot. “He followed her. By threatening to cause physical harm, he raped the woman. After the assault, he fled from the spot,” Banjara Hills inspector Suhasan said.The survivor, who identified the accused, approached police on Sunday. Based on her complaint, Banjara Hills police have registered a case under Section 64 ( rape ) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). “The complainant was sent for a medical examination and her statement was also recorded. The accused was arrested on Tuesday and remanded to judicial custody. He was earlier involved in some theft cases,” the inspector said.
Article Summary: The 60-year-old woman works as a domestic help. She went to collect blankets near a hospital in Banjara Hills. The 32- year-old accused, who is the neighbour of the victim, spotted her going to a secluded spot. By threatening to cause physical harm, he raped the woman.

Article Title: Ponnam accuses BJP of diverting public attention over SIR concerns, demands special session of Parliament
Article Text:
BC welfare minister Ponnam Prabhakar

Hyderabad:





BC welfare minister Ponnam Prabhakar on Tuesday strongly criticised the BJP for allegedly diverting public attention from serious concerns over the SIR of electoral rolls by raising the issue of infiltrators. He challenged the BJP leadership to respond to the questions raised by AICC leader Rahul Gandhi regarding voter deletions, alterations to electoral data and the independence of Election Commission Reacting to BJP national president Nitin Nabin ’s visit to Karimnagar, Ponnam said the BJP leader had failed to address Telangana ’s development needs, funds due from the Centre and local issues. Instead, he had focused on criticising Rahul Gandhi, Delhi politics and religious sentiments. The minister described the Karimnagar meeting as lacking substance and said it offered nothing beyond political rhetoric.He also questioned why the BJP was reluctant to convene a special session of Parliament to discuss SIR. Referring to allegations of voter deletions in different states, Ponnam asked whether Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath had not expressed concern over the removal of one crore voters.The minister clarified that the Congress was not seeking protection for votes belonging to alleged illegal infiltrators but wanted to know what the Union home minister was doing to prevent illegal infiltration. He questioned how infiltrators could get registered as voters when the BJP was in power at the Centre.Ponnam challenged the BJP to explain what the Centre had done for Telangana over the past 12 years and how much financial assistance it had extended to the state. He said the BJP should come forward for an open debate on development instead of resorting to religious polarisation and criticising opposition leaders. He added that the party should explain the promises made to Telangana and the progress achieved in fulfilling them.He demanded that Nitin Nabin withdraw his remarks against Rahul Gandhi, asserting that attempts to mislead people through emotional appeals and the politics of hatred would not succeed.
Article Summary: BC welfare minister Ponnam Prabhakar criticised the BJP for allegedly diverting public attention from serious concerns over the SIR of electoral rolls. He challenged the BJP leadership to respond to the questions raised by AICC leader Rahul Gandhi regarding voter deletions, alterations to electoral data.

Article Title: Man held for damaging two Karunanidhi statues, glass panels of DMK library and office in Erode
Article Text:
The Erode district police launched an intensive investigation and examined CCTV footage. The footage revealed that the same man had visited the various locations and caused the damage.





ERODE: The Erode district police on Tuesday arrested a man on charges of damaging two statues of late Tamil Nadu chief minister M Karunanidhi , a library and a DMK party office.The incidents came to light after the spectacles on the Karunanidhi statue at Panneerselvam Park in Erode were found broken. The Karunanidhi statue at Alangattu Valasu in Modakkurichi was also damaged.“The glass panels of a library situated beneath Karunanidhi’s statue in the Municipal Colony area were damaged. In another incident, the front glass facade of the DMK district headquarters at Manalmedu was found shattered,” said a party functionary.The Erode district police launched an intensive investigation and examined CCTV footage. The footage revealed that the same man had visited the various locations and caused the damage.“Based on the investigation, police identified the suspect as Hari Vignesh, 26, of Thottipalayam Pudur near Modakkurichi,” said superintendent of police D V Kiran Shruthi. The man, who was drunk on Monday night, also damaged the doors and window panes of his own house as well as the windows of some vehicles.Police said legal action would be initiated. Preliminary inquiries indicated that the man might be suffering from mental health-related issues.
Article Summary: The incidents came to light after the spectacles on the Karunanidhi statue at Panneerselvam Park in Erode were found broken. The glass panels of a library situated beneath the statue were also damaged. The front glass facade of the DMK district headquarters at Manalmedu was found shattered.

Article Title: No bulletproof vehicle or commando escort for jailed Bishnoi gang lawyer, Delhi court directs Tihar jail to ensure safety
Article Text:
Jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi (File photo)

(With Agency Inputs)





NEW DELHI: A Delhi court has directed Tihar jail authorities to ensure the safety and security of Deepak Nanda, a lawyer associated with jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi , both inside the prison and during transit whenever he is taken out.The court also directed the authorities to keep Nanda separate from members of the Rohit Godara gang in jail. However, it declined his request for a bulletproof vehicle and a specialised armed commando escort during movement outside the prison.Rohit Godara is the gangster who claimed responsibility for the murder of Rashtriya Rajput Karni Sena chief Sukhdev Singh Gogamedi. He is believed to be operating his gang from the US.Special Judge Kiran Bansal was hearing a plea filed by Nanda, also known as Deepak Khatri, who is lodged in Tihar jail in connection with an FIR registered by the Delhi Police Crime Branch. The case involves charges of organised crime, cheating and criminal conspiracy under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), along with offences under the Arms Act.In his application, Nanda sought directions to the jail authorities to ensure his safety during transit outside the prison for any purpose.He also sought a "dedicated high-risk security guard/specialised armed commando escort" and a "bullet-proof vehicle/bullet-proof jail van" whenever he was moved out of jail.The plea stated that on February 24, 2026, members of the Rohit Godara gang attacked Nanda outside the Marghat Wale Baba temple. The attackers allegedly opened fire at the car in which he was travelling with his friends, injuring a co-passenger. An FIR was subsequently registered at Kashmere Gate police station.According to the plea, Nanda had earlier approached the Delhi High Court, which, through an order dated April 17 this year, provided him with one personal security officer (PSO).The application claimed that the police intelligence wing and jail authorities were aware of the high-risk threat to Nanda. It alleged that his existing security was "highly vulnerable, non-bulletproof and easily penetrable by automated assault weapons".Moving him in ordinary vehicles "poses a catastrophic risk", the plea stated.In its November 19 order, the court noted that it had earlier sought responses from the concerned authorities. The investigating officer's (IO's) reply stated that security during judicial custody and transportation was the responsibility of the jail authorities and the Nyayik Abhiraksha Vahini (NAV), the police unit responsible for escorting prisoners to and from courts.The court also took note of the response filed by the deputy superintendent of Tihar jail, who said Nanda had been lodged "safely in a separate ward". Jail staff had been instructed to maintain "extra vigil and heightened security", with round-the-clock monitoring, the reply stated.The deputy commissioner of police (DCP), 3rd Battalion, informed the court that a threat assessment had been carried out through the NAV, Delhi Armed Police (DAP) and Nanda himself.According to the DCP, the assessment found that "no credible or specific threat to the life and safety of the UTP has been found during custody", and "therefore, no specific facility can be given to the applicant/accused".The officer, however, outlined several precautionary measures. Nanda would be kept separately from prisoners he feared while travelling in jail vans and in court lock-ups. The in-charge of the jail van would announce the names of undertrial prisoners (UTPs) while boarding, allowing Nanda to identify any known rival so that preventive measures could be taken."It is further stated that in-charge, lock-ups, and in-charge, jails, have been directed to produce the UTP from lock-ups to courts and from jail to hospital under custody of two police personnel and also to lodge him separately from the members of Rohit Godara Gang as well as that of anti-gangs of Lawrence Bishnoi gang," the court noted.The DCP also suggested that the issue "can easily be solved" by mentioning the threat perception and the names of threatening prisoners on the warrants, enabling authorities to keep Nanda separate in the jail van and court lock-up.In its order, the court said, "In view of the reply filed, it is directed that safety and security of accused/applicant (Nanda) be maintained in jail as well as during transit whenever he is taken out from jail for any purpose."The court further directed that Nanda be produced through video-conferencing (VC), unless there was a specific direction requiring his physical presence."Further, he be lodged separately from the members of Rohit Godara Gang. On the warrants of the applicant/accused, the threat perception and name of threatening UTP may be mentioned by the jail superintendent," it added.A warrant is the document authorising a prisoner's detention and accompanies him between the jail, lock-up and court.On Nanda's specific requests for enhanced security arrangements, the court said that "in view of the replies filed by the respective agencies, no further directions are called for".
Article Summary: Deepak Nanda is a lawyer associated with jailed gangster Lawrence Bishnoi. Nanda, also known as Deepak Khatri, is lodged in Tihar jail in connection with an FIR registered by the Delhi Police Crime Branch. The case involves charges of organised crime, cheating and criminal conspiracy under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

Article Title: ​Rajya Sabha MP Wadkute passes away
Article Text:
Ramrao Wadkute

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Rajya Sabha member and BJP leader Ramrao Wadkute died at AIIMS in New Delhi late on Saturday after suffering a severe heart attack. He was 72.Wadkute was admitted to AIIMS on Nov 20 after complaining of cough and chest discomfort. He suffered a heart attack and died while undergoing treatment, party leaders said.A resident of Kalamnuri in Hingoli district, Wadkute was a prominent leader of the Dhangar community in Marathwada and was known as a simple, grassroots politician.Condoling his death, chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said Wadkute’s demise was the loss of a simple and dedicated political leader who was deeply committed to grassroots welfare.“He shouldered many organizational responsibilities for the BJP in Hingoli district. He did a great deal of work for the Dhangar community. He left his mark on the cooperative sector as well. His concern for grassroots communities was always evident,” the CM said.Wadkute began his political career with Nationalist Congress Party and served as a member of Maharashtra Legislative Council from June 2014 to Oct 2019. He was also president of Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Maharashtra Sheep and Goat Development Corporation Limited.He left the NCP in Oct 2019 and joined the BJP. In 2021, he was appointed BJP’s Hingoli district president. He also served as the party’s election chief and in-charge for the Hingoli Lok Sabha constituency. The BJP nominated him for the Rajya Sabha from Maharashtra in March this year.BJP Hingoli district president Gajanan Ghuge said last rites on Wadkute were scheduled on Tuesday morning. “His body will be flown to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on Monday, and will be taken to Parbhani first and later at Hingoli. The last rites will be performed when his daughter arrives from the US,” he said.Wadkute is survived by his wife, two sons and a daughter.
Article Summary: Wadkute was admitted to AIIMS on Nov 20 after complaining of cough and chest discomfort. He suffered a heart attack and died while undergoing treatment, party leaders said. He was a prominent leader of the Dhangar community in Marathwada.

Article Title: Raut claims Rs 150cr being offered to MPs to back delimitation bill, Mahajan says allegations childish
Article Text:
File photo

Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

:





Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed on Saturday that MPs were being offered “Rs 150 crore to back the proposed delimitation bill”, even as BJP minister Girish Mahajan dismissed it as a “childish allegation”.Raut also said that BJP would not return to power in 2029 if the current political atmosphere and public pressure continued. He added that Congress party’s performance in Rajasthan’s panchayat elections reflected the country’s changing mood.Interacting with the media during his visit to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar on Saturday, Raut alleged that BJP was attempting to secure support for the proposed delimitation bill and questioned why a Parliament session was not being convened.“Remember this figure if Maharashtra ’s MPs support the bill,” Raut said, alleging that some prominent politicians in the state had been entrusted with arranging the money and securing support. He also questioned Union home minister Amit Shah ’s frequent visits to Mumbai over the past two months, alleging that political negotiations were being conducted from the city.BJP minister Girish Mahajan, speaking in Jalgaon, said that Raut makes “childish allegations.No one takes him seriously anymore.”Raut said Congress’s good performance in Rajasthan’s panchayat samiti and zilla parishad elections was the outcome of public pressure preventing electoral malpractice and keeping the election machinery under check. “If this public pressure continues until 2029, the BJP will not return to power. It is not 100% but 500% certain,” he said.
Article Summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut claimed MPs were being offered “Rs 150 crore to back the proposed delimitation bill’ Raut also said that BJP would not return to power in 2029 if the current political atmosphere and public pressure continued.

Article Title: 25,000 autorickshaws stay off roads in Kolhapur
Article Text:
Around 25,000 autorickshaws stayed off Kolhapur’s roads on Monday during a statewide strike against app-based bike-taxi services such as Rapido and Uber, leaving students, commuters and tourists scrambling for transport.

Kolhapur

:





Around 25,000 autorickshaws stayed off Kolhapur’s roads on Monday during a statewide strike against app-based bike-taxi services such as Rapido and Uber , leaving students, commuters and tourists scrambling for transport.Drivers also protested outside the district collector’s office and submitted a memorandum to collector Vijay Rathod. Their key demands are a permanent ban on bike taxis, exemption for autorickshaws from automated vehicle testing and mandatory permits for e-rickshaws.The unions alleged that app-based bike taxis were carrying passengers without mandatory commercial permits, driver badges and yellow number plates. They claimed this was hurting the livelihoods of licensed auto and taxi drivers and raised passenger safety concerns.They also opposed mandatory fitness tests at privately operated automated testing stations. The unions alleged that even well-maintained autos were being declared unfit, imposing additional costs on drivers.They demanded permits for e-rickshaws, alleging many were operating without permits or driving licences and creating unfair competition for licensed operators.Union leader Rajendra Jadhav urged govt to address the drivers’ concerns. He also appealed to deputy chief minister Eknath Shinde to intervene.“Growing regulatory hurdles and unauthorised services are making it increasingly difficult for drivers to support their families and educate their children,” Jadhav said.Congress MLC Satej Patil visited the protest and backed the drivers. “Nearly 15 lakh autorickshaw drivers across Maharashtra contribute significantly to govt revenue. Yet, govt is destroying the livelihoods of these hardworking people. Only five to eight drivers in Kolhapur district have benefited from the welfare boards announced by the govt,” Patil said.The unions threatened to intensify the agitation in phases across Maharashtra if state and central govts failed to address their demands.
Article Summary: Around 25,000 autorickshaws stayed off Kolhapur’s roads on Monday during a statewide strike against app-based bike-taxi services such as Rapido and Uber. Their key demands are a permanent ban on bike taxis, exemption for autorickhaws from automated vehicle testing and mandatory permits for e-rickshaws.

Article Title: Five in custody for smuggling pangolin body parts in Karvir
Article Text:
Kolhapur

:





Forest department officials arrested five men for allegedly trying to sell 5 kg of pangolin scales and other body parts at Mauje Karanjfen village in Karvir taluka.Acting on a tip-off, teams from the Karvir and Panhala forest ranges laid a trap and caught the accused. Officials seized the pangolin parts from them.The accused were identified as Lahu Dhaku Hadkar (60) of Kankavali taluka in Sindhudurg district and Dnyandev Sattu Savare (46), Prakash Shankar Patil (50), Nathaji Yashwant Patil (39) and Bajirao Bandopant Malave (38), all from Shahuwadi taluka in Kolhapur district.A case was registered under the Wildlife (Protection) Act and the accused were produced before a court.Pangolins receive the highest level of legal protection under Schedule I of the Act. Hunting, poaching, possessing, transporting, buying or selling pangolins or their scales is a cognisable and non-bailable offence.
Article Summary: Forest department officials arrested five men for allegedly trying to sell 5 kg of pangolin scales and other body parts. Teams from Karvir and Panhala forest ranges laid a trap and caught the accused. Pangolins receive the highest level of legal protection under Schedule I of the Act.

Article Title: 50-year-old man accused of spiking woman's drink, raping her at Belapur lodge
Article Text:
Image used for representational purposes.

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines





NAVI MUMBAI: A 25-year-old woman on Monday lodged a rape complaint at CBD-Belapur police station against habitual offender Shailendra Dwivedi (50), who allegedly posed as a journalist.Dwivedi was arrested by Ulwe police on November 12 in a cheating and criminal breach of trust case for allegedly duping Thane trader Vijay Jha and four others of Rs 19 lakh in a flat sale deal. He is currently lodged in Taloja jail.Senior inspector Arun Pawar of CBD-Belapur police station said the woman alleged that on May 30 last year, she had attended a birthday party at Arush Hotel in Sector 15, CBD-Belapur, and was also there to collect Rs 10,000 from Jha. Dwivedi, who was present at the party, allegedly spiked her soft drink. After she felt dizzy, he took her to Arush Lodge and sexually assaulted her.She further alleged that Dwivedi threatened to kill her and her family if she disclosed the incident to anyone. He also threatened to circulate an intimate video, which he had allegedly recorded on his mobile phone.Pawar said, "The woman claimed that she did not approach the police earlier because of Dwivedi's threats.After learning that he had been arrested in another case and lodged in jail, she came forward and registered an FIR against him."Police have invoked relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) relating to rape, administering stupefying or intoxicating substances, aggravated criminal intimidation and intentional insult with intent to provoke a breach of public peace.(The victim's identity has not been revealed to protect her privacy as per Supreme Court directives on cases related to sexual assault)
Article Summary: A 25-year-old woman on Monday lodged a rape complaint at CBD-Belapur police station against habitual offender Shailendra Dwivedi (50), who allegedly posed as a journalist. He was arrested by Ulwe police on November 12 in a cheating and criminal breach of trust case for allegedly duping Thane trader Vijay Jha. He is currently lodged in Taloja jail.

Article Title: CM Order: 8-Mth Farm Loan Recovery Curb On Microfins
Article Text:
Nagpur:





Revenue minister Chandrashekhar Bawankule, citing directives from chief minister Devendra Fadnavis , on Monday said that micro finance companies have been told not to recover loans from drought-hit farmers for the next eight months.Bawankule added that instructions have been given to everyone, from the talathi onwards, to hold meetings with micro finance companies and set things right.BJP MLC Parinay Fuke claimed some of these firms are trying to seize farmers’ homes and land. Bawankule said heads of micro finance companies have assured him that they will not recover loans. “They also said that illegal micro finance outfits have started in the name of micro finance and begun recovery, just as illegal moneylenders cropped up in the name of licensed ones. We have taken a strict stand against them,” the minister said.As per Fuke, Fadnavis has also asked banks and micro finance companies not to trouble drought-hit farmers. “Farmers are in deep distress and no one should be harassed or forced to pay. Even then, some micro finance companies are trying to take over houses and land. We received many complaints, so we have issued a helpline number for farmers of Bhandara and Gondia,” Fuke said.Two complaints came in, Fuke said, and the farmers got possession of their houses back. “Wherever such incidents happen, we reach the spot. We will take action against micro finance companies in such cases,” he said.The BJP MLC also took a swipe at NCP (SP) MLA Rohit Pawar , who has planned a tractor march to Nagpur during the winter session of the state legislature. “Rohit should hold rally against certain agriculture firms based in Baramati. If he is sensitive to farmers, then that Baramati agro firm should raise the cane price. That is our demand,” he said.Bawankule, who chairs the cabinet subcommittee on drought relief, said govt’s doors are open for Pawar to discuss farmer issues. “We are ready to answer every question he has raised. If he marches without talking to us, that is politics, and farmers should remember that such marches serve political interests. The govt stands behind farmers,” he said.
Article Summary: BJP MLC Parinay Fuke claimed some of these firms are trying to seize farmers’ homes and land. Bawankule said heads of micro finance companies have assured him that they will not recover loans. “We received many complaints, so we have issued a helpline number for farmers of Bhandara and Gondia,” Fuke said.

Article Title: Four held arrested in Ghoti robbery case
Article Text:
Nashik:





The Nashik Rural police have arrested four suspects allegedly involved in a night-time robbery on Khodala Road in the Devgaon area, under the Ghoti police station limits.The accused have been identified as Kashinath Khode (29) and Sanjay Bhangre (30), residents of Bhilmal, and Vaibhav Zole (19) and Kiran Khade (29), residents of Dhadoshi. All four are from Trimbakeshwar taluka in Nashik district.The robbery occurred on the night of Nov 16. According to the complaint filed by Sagar Shedwal, a resident of Pen in Raigad district, he was travelling by car with his family when unidentified persons allegedly blocked their vehicle using another car.The accused reportedly threatened Shedwal and his family members at knifepoint before forcibly taking gold ornaments, cash, an ATM card, and a driving licence, together valued at Rs 1.74 lakh. They then fled in their car.On Shedwal’s complaint, the Ghoti police registered a case of armed robbery under relevant sections of the BNS. “Soon after receiving information about the robbery, a patrolling team from Ghoti police station visited the scene,” a police officer said.Guided by senior officers, Local Crime Branch inspector Rahul More and Ghoti police station inspector Vijay Shinde gathered confidential intelligence based on the modus operandi of the criminals, their descriptions, dialect and the vehicle used in the crime.Police arrested four suspects during a search in Trimbakeshwar taluka. During interrogation, they admitted to committing the crime with accomplices. Police also seized the sports utility vehicle used in the crime and their cell phones.
Article Summary: Nashik Rural police have arrested four suspects allegedly involved in a night- time robbery. The accused have been identified as Kashinath Khode, Sanjay Bhangre, Vaibhav Zole and Kiran Khade. All four are from Trimbakeshwar taluka in Nashik district.

Article Title: TVK MLA booked for 'sending obscene messages' to Kallakurichi Collector
Article Text:
Kallakurichi All-Women Police filed a case against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA C Arul Vignesh.





CHENNAI: Kallakurichi All-Women Police registered a case against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) MLA C Arul Vignesh on Tuesday following a complaint by the district Collector accusing him of sending obscene messages to her mobile phone.The case was registered under Section 4(1) of the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and Section 294 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).The Collector submitted a written complaint to the Kallakurichi Superintendent of Police on November 23, following reports of inappropriate messages and advances by the MLA.The National Commission for Women (NCW) took suo motu cognisance of the matter on November 15 and urged the Tamil Nadu Director-General of Police to conduct an impartial inquiry and submit an action-taken report.On November 23, the Madras High Court heard a petition seeking registration of an FIR. Justice V Lakshminarayanan observed that the court could not act solely on media reports without a complaint from the person concerned. The Collector subsequently submitted her complaint on Monday following which the Kallakurichi AWPS police registered a case.Arul Vignesh had denied the allegations, describing them as false social media rumours. DMK president M K Stalin demanded the MLA’s arrest and criticised the alleged failure to act on the complaint.
Article Summary: Kallakurichi All-Women Police registered a case against Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) MLA C Arul Vignesh. The case was filed following a complaint by the district Collector accusing him of sending obscene messages to her mobile phone.

Article Title: ‘Justice delayed is justice denied’: DMK deputy general secretary Kanimozhi Karunanidhi questions Vijay’s silence over Kallakurichi collector row
Article Text:
Chief minister C Joseph Vijay and DMK deputy general secretary Kanimozhi Karunanidhi





CHENNAI: DMK deputy general secretary Kanimozhi Karunanidhi, who was the first to flag the alleged misconduct on X and bring the issue into the public domain, has slammed chief minister C Joseph Vijay for his prolonged inaction in the Kallakurichi Collector harassment row, warning that “justice delayed is justice denied”.Taking to social media shortly after reports emerged that the Collector had filed a formal police complaint against ruling TVK MLA C Arul Vignesh, Kanimozhi noted that she had demanded an inquiry and strict action as soon as the incident first surfaced. She hit back at critics who had previously accused her, the DMK and other leaders of politicising women's safety when they raised the alarm.Applauding the Collector for her courage in taking on a ruling party legislator, Kanimozhi called her a role model for all women enduring workplace harassment. Questioning the CM's silence over the past several weeks, she asked whether Vijay would act against the MLA at least now or continue prioritising the protection of a party member facing serious allegations over women's safety.Meanwhile, Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin also came down heavily on the Vijay government, asking whether a “dummy CM” was running the state to protect sexual offenders.He pointed out that the District Collector had complained to Chief Secretary M Sai Kumar over the phone a month ago, yet no action was taken.Instead, he alleged, the government had lied to the Madras High Court by claiming that no complaint had been received from the officer.Udhayanidhi questioned whether the CM was unaware of the matter, whether the Chief Secretary had kept it under wraps, or whether Vijay had refrained from acting to protect his government. “The CM should explain what exactly happened and what the truth is,” he demanded.
Article Summary: DMK deputy general secretary Kanimozhi Karunanidhi was the first to flag the alleged misconduct on X. She hit back at critics who had previously accused her, the DMK and other leaders of politicising women's safety. Leader of the Opposition Udhayanidhi Stalin also came down heavily on the Vijay government.

Article Title: Man arrested for assaulting police constable in Coimbatore
Article Text: COIMBATORE: A 37-year-old man was arrested on charges of assaulting and abusing a police constable while the latter was on duty at Kurichi in the city on Sunday.The arrested man has been identified as G Boopathi of Gandhi Road near Kurichi.According to police, S Sanjeev Gandhi, a Grade II police constable attached to the Sundarapuram police station, was on patrol duty with a police inspector near the Indian National Congress party office on Sunday. Boopathi, a committee member of the Aravan temple, picked an argument with the constable over a temple festival. During the argument, he grabbed the constable’s uniform, pushed and abused him, obstructed him from discharging his official duties and threatened to murder anyone who tried to stop him. Onlookers intervened and separated him from the cop.Sanjeevanandhi lodged a complaint with the Sundarapuram police on Sunday. Police registered a case under sections 296(b), 132 and 351(2) of BNS.Boopathi was remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: A 37-year-old man was arrested on charges of assaulting and abusing a police constable while the latter was on duty at Kurichi in the city on Sunday. The arrested man has been identified as G Boopathi of Gandhi Road near Kurichi. He was remanded in judicial custody.

Article Title: TNEB employee held with ganja in Mettur
Article Text:
Salem





: A suspended electricity board employee was arrested on Saturday for smuggling ganja on his two-wheeler in Mettur.Police identified the arrested person as M Joseph, 47, of Matha Kovil area in Mettur. According to an investigation officer, Joseph was nabbed while they were conducting a routine vehicle check along the right bank of Mettur dam on Kolathur Road.“He was riding a two-wheeler in a suspicious manner. Upon inspecting the vehicle, we found 900 grams of ganja concealed inside the seat cover. We seized the contraband and took Joseph to the police station for interrogation.”Investigations revealed that Joseph was already facing a ganja smuggling case, which had led to his suspension from the electricity board.Police registered a case, arrested him and produced him before the Mettur court, which remanded him in judicial custody. Joseph was subsequently lodged in the Salem Central Prison.
Article Summary: A suspended electricity board employee was arrested on Saturday for smuggling ganja on his two-wheeler. Police identified the arrested person as M Joseph, 47, of Matha Kovil area in Mettur. Joseph was already facing a ganjan smuggling case, which led to his suspension from the electricity board.

Article Title: Traffic diversions announced in Krishnagiri in view of festivals
Article Text:
traffic diversions

Krishnagiri

:





District police have announced traffic diversions for heavy vehicles and non-pilgrim traffic from 2pm on November 22 to 6am on November 26, in view of Tiruvannamalai Maharatham and Karthigai Deepam festivals.In a media statement, SP GS Anitha stated that heavy vehicles travelling from Bengaluru to Tiruvannamalai , Villupuram, Cuddalore and Puducherry must take the Krishnagiri-Vaniyambadi-Vellore-Cheyyar-Vandavasi-Tindivanam route instead of proceeding through Uthangarai, Chengam and Tiruvannamalai.Vehicles from Bengaluru bound for Vriddhachalam, Chidambaram and Nagapattinam through Krishnagiri will be diverted via Dharmapuri, Thoppur, Salem, Vazhapadi, and Attur.Vehicles from Bargur towards Tiruvannamalai and those arriving through Kuppam will be diverted via Vaniyambadi, Vellore, Cheyyar, Vandavasi, and Tindivanam. Heavy vehicles arriving from Dharmapuri through Manjamedu will be diverted at Puliyur Junction towards Tiruvannamalai Road instead of Pochampally Road.Heavy vehicles travelling from Krishnagiri towards Tiruvannamalai will be diverted to Bargur Road at Jagadevi.All vehicles heading from Krishnagiri to Tiruvannamalai will also be diverted at Kannandahalli near Mathur police station towards Tirupattur.Heavy vehicles using Krishnagiri bypass roads will be diverted at Uthangarai MGR Nagar through Karapattu, Kathavani and Arunapathi toll road towards Tirupattur. Those arriving from Salem via Harur and Uthangarai for Tiruvannamalai will also be redirected through Tirupattur.Heavy vehicles travelling from Tirupattur towards Tiruvannamalai via Singarapettai and Chengam will be rerouted towards Tirupattur. Vehicles from Dharmapuri district proceeding via Irumathur, Puliyur, and Olapatti will use alternative routes notified by police.The SP explained the arrangements at a consultation meeting with truck drivers’ welfare association office-bearers at the district police office and sought their cooperation.
Article Summary: Heavy vehicles travelling from Bengaluru to Tiruvannamalai must take the Krishnagiri-Vaniyambadi-Vellore-Cheyyar-Vandavasi-Tindivanam route. Vehicles from Dharmapuri district proceeding via Irumathur, Puliyur, and Olapatti will use alternative routes.

A man was arrested on Thursday for allegedly attacking a woman with scissors after she opposed his alleged pressure to convert and plan to marry another woman. The accused was arrested near COD bridge in Kanpur by Railbazar police.The woman, a resident of Kanpur, alleged in her complaint that the accused married her at a temple about five years ago and took her to Noida. She accused him of subsequently assaulting her and pressuring her to convert.She gave birth to a son in Sept. She alleged that the accused then called her back to Kanpur on the false assurance that he would perform nikah with her and accommodate her at his parents’ house. After arriving, she learnt that he was preparing to marry another woman.When she opposed the proposed marriage and refused to convert despite alleged pressure from Kaleem and his family, he attacked her neck with scissors with the intention of killing her, according to the complaint. He subsequently fled.Acting station house officer Ashish Chaubey said police registered a case under relevant sections based on the woman’s written complaint.During questioning, the accused admitted that he was attempting to flee to Noida. He was produced before a court and sent to jail.

Article Title: 864 bottles of liquor seized from house near Erode; man arrested
Article Text: ERODE: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district in the early hours of Thursday and arrested a man.Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid at the house of K Govindaraj, 28, of Ammapalayam. They found 864 bottles of IMFL stocked in the house for illegal sale.Police registered a case and arrested Govindaraj. He was remanded in judicial custody.They launched a search for Sekar alias Ammasai, 34, and Sridhar, 38, who have links with the illegal liquor operation.
Article Summary: Police seized 864 bottles of Indian made foreign liquor (IMFL) from a house near Mylambadi in Erode district. Acting on a tip-off that bottles of liquor had been illegally stored for unauthorised sale, the Bhavani police conducted a raid.

SALEM: A govt school teacher was arrested in Salem district on Sunday night under sections of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act on charges of inappropriate behaviour towards girl students.The arrested teacher, M Sankar, 49, of Vinayagapuram, is serving as a social science teacher in a govt school in the district.According to the complaint, the teacher allegedly made inappropriate remarks to Class X girl students on Nov 5. “He is accused of making a heart-shaped hand gesture towards one student and calling another student ‘Cleopatra’ while commenting on the beauty of her eyes,” said an officer at the all women police station in Attur.The students brought the matter to the notice of the headmaster on Nov 13. The headmaster informed chief educational officer A Ellappan and contacted Childline 1098 seeking intervention.Following the complaint, a member of the child welfare committee visited the school on Nov 14 and conducted an inquiry into the allegations raised by the students.Based on the findings, the headmaster lodged a complaint with the Attur all women police on Sunday. Police registered a case against Sankar and arrested him. He was remanded in judicial custody.
Article Summary: The arrested teacher, M Sankar, 49, of Vinayagapuram, is serving as a social science teacher in a govt school in the district. He is accused of making a heart-shaped hand gesture towards one student and calling another student ‘Cleopatra’
